title: Dispatch RFU 5: A Child Is Seen in the Rising Shower
summary: The figure appears in the old street but casts a shadow on the new stones.
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: A child in a dark coat stood for several seconds among the cloud’s chimney pots. Mrs. Marr recognized the coat from a photograph of her brother Jonah, lost in the 1949 flood. Dr. Saye cautions that recognition cannot establish a person’s identity across such a distance.

A shadow of the child fell on the courtyard below. Jonah’s name appears in the flood report as missing, not dead. Mrs. Marr has asked the Institute to keep the court open until she can learn whether he is trying to reach it.
